summary: Master the art of real estate asset management with our comprehensive training course. Unlock your potential and drive success in your real estate career.
lede: Real estate asset management helps property and investment professionals link building-level actions to portfolio goals and make defensible decisions. Training covers diagnosing net operating income, analyzing lease risk, prioritizing capital expenditure, testing valuation assumptions, and translating performance data into downside scenarios, dashboards, and investment papers for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This real estate asset management course is designed for property professionals who already work with leases, budgets, investment assumptions, building performance, or portfolio reporting and now need to coordinate those inputs into defensible asset decisions.
prerequisites: Required knowledge: Familiarity with leases, property budgets, rent rolls, valuation assumptions, and basic investment metrics. Technology: Bring a laptop with a current spreadsheet application. Microsoft Excel is preferred for the supplied models. Power BI Desktop is optional for dashboard exploration, while ARGUS Enterprise access is optional because its workflow receives demonstration and conceptual coverage. Coding requirement: No programming is required for course completion.
